notes.title: Mystic Fishing: A Fantasy RPG - DEMO AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497317/34a8b544b87e1258702211a1c7e74fd2a1b002b2.png[/img]
Hello everybody, my name is Xinitii.

Today I am happy to announce that I have finally pushed through a brand new [b]DEMO[/b] for [i]Mystic Fishing![/i]

I've been working hard on this demo and I'm so glad to finally be able to share it with you all.

[h3]Demo Covers:[/h3]

🎣First 3 Fishing Biomes of the game

🎣19 Total Fish (Including 15 regular fish, 3 unique aberrations. and a special boss fish)

🎣Post-demo Special Boss with increased difficulty (seriously)

🎣Over 10+ fishing skills for you to try out

🎣About 1hr and 30mins of story and dialogue (more if you engage in side content)

🎣Random events scattered across the world to find

🎣A "Fish Book" cataloguing all fish able to be caught in the demo

🎣9 different achievements to collect!

In the full release, these same biomes will contain even more fish (about double the demo's amount), there will be a [i]Fishing Encyclopedia [/i]which will be a book containing a full page of art and real life facts about each fish in the game, and also around 90-100+ fish to catch (both real and fantastical)! Along with around 10+ fishing biomes, side quests, and special heart-to-heart events, the full game will have lots of fun content to interact with!

I am a solo dev on this project, so please be kind about any bugs or grammar mistakes. That being said, I'd appreciate any and all feedback you may have for me. I'm working very hard on this project and would love to hear what you have to say.

I really hope you enjoy my demo and wishlist the game if you are interested! Thank you for your support.

-Xinitii

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511450/Mystic_Fishing_A_Fantasy_Fishing_RPG/
